name: Station Rows
summary: Hold Shift to add or remove a whole row of railway station modules.
description:
Enable the mod and configure a vanilla modular passenger or cargo railway station. Select a track, platform, roof or attachment module, hold Shift and click an available slot to fill the row along the tracks. With the removal tool, hold Shift and click a module to remove the same type of module in that row. Release Shift for normal single-module actions. If you changed key bindings, use your precision-mode modifier.

The range follows the station's existing track/platform length and includes the clicked position. Occupied slots are skipped. Roofs and attachments are added only over existing passenger platforms; removing a platform also removes its roof and attachments. Non-longitudinal modules, such as station buildings, remain single-click operations.

Hovering shows the normal one-module preview. Row construction is performed module by module. Remaining steps stop if the game rejects a step, the station changes while waiting, or an error occurs; completed changes are retained.

zh_CN.name: 车站整列配置
zh_CN.summary: 按住Shift，整列增删原版火车站轨道、站台和附属模块。
zh_CN.description:
启用后，配置原版模块化客运或货运火车站。选择轨道、站台、顶棚或附属模块，按住Shift点击可建槽位，沿铁轨方向补齐整列。使用删除工具时，按住Shift点击模块，删除同列的同类模块。松开Shift恢复逐块操作；修改过按键绑定时，以“精确模式”修饰键为准。

添加范围以车站现有轨道和站台的纵向长度为界，包含点击位置并跳过已占用槽位。顶棚和附属模块仅补在已有客运站台上；删除站台时同时删除顶棚及附属模块。站房等非纵向模块仍为单点操作。

悬停显示原版单块预览。整列施工逐块完成；某一步被游戏拒绝、车站在等待期间发生变更或出现错误时，停止后续操作，保留已完成的施工。
